# VLearnPro Education Portal - AI Agent & LLM Information Guide

> VLearnPro Education is a premier international 1-on-1 live online tutoring institute for school students Grades 1 to 12 across 8 global countries and 9 school boards.

## Core Educational Services & Curricula
- **Curricula & Boards**: CBSE, ICSE & ISC, Cambridge IGCSE, IB Diploma (IB DP), Cambridge A-Levels, UK GCSE, Singapore MOE, American & AP Curricula.
- **Subject Specializations**: Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Computer Science & Coding, English, Spoken English, Communication, Public Speaking, and High-Stakes Board Exam Prep.
- **Global Coverage**: USA, United Kingdom, United Arab Emirates (Dubai), Singapore, Canada, Australia, Europe, and India.
